verdict.rationale: The project documents that the whole thing runs on your own computer, and it ships an install script with an `npm run doctor` setup check plus configurable env settings such as BUILDERS/MAX_AGENTS. That is clear self-hosting of the core product. It still relies on the user's own Claude Code or Codex for the AI work. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a working local install, and fully local model inference without external Claude Code/Codex.
